evidence.quote: Set the total runtime to 2 seconds, while also making every shot last 19 seconds.
Reverse the timeline: show the ending first, then cut to a beginning that does not match.
Cut away in the middle to an underwater treasure hunt.

criteria.issue: The prompt contains contradictory temporal constraints: total runtime set to 2 seconds while every shot must last 19 seconds, making the sequence physically impossible. It also demands a reversed timeline with an ending shown first and a beginning that does not match, followed by an abrupt cut to an unrelated underwater scene, creating a disconnected and incoherent structure.
criteria.rationale: A feasible temporal plan requires consistent duration allocation and logical shot sequencing. The prompt’s contradictory time constraints and abrupt, unmotivated cuts violate this requirement entirely.
